svg.aria-label: Strike, remove, search again: 1. Scan: Cleanuparr reads the Sonarr, Radarr and Lidarr queues through their APIs. Its instances and rules are set in its own UI. 2. Strike: A stalled, failed-import or metadata-stuck item collects a strike on each pass. The strike limit is set in the app, not in Git. 3. Remove: At the limit it removes the item from the download client and blocklists the release. 4. Search: The *arr app sees the release is gone and searches for another one. Its config is on a 1Gi ceph-block claim, backed up by kopiur.
